text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: SEV2 page fired for service=redwood-edge (alert: canary-error-rate-high). Link: https://pd.example/incidents/PD12345 - 5xx surge observed in canary (edge-v2-canary) in us-west1, endpoint /v1/embeddings.

pagerduty: Triggered runbook: https://wiki.redwood/incident/PD12345 - notify oncall SRE and product ops.

maria: ack @here i'm oncall, looking now. starting triage - which canary batch?

chen: ack - i'm available. saw 5xx spike ~2m ago after 20% traffic ramp. reproduction looks like batch embedding requests hitting a quantized kernel path.

leo: adding logs from the canary host (us-west1-edge-23):
```
[2026-03-15T14:22:31Z] ERROR coprocessor: grpc error: 13 INTERNAL: cudnnLaunch failed
[2026-03-15T14:22:31Z] WARN kvcache: invalidation miss spike
[2026-03-15T14:22:32Z] ERROR http: handler /v1/embeddings 500 x 120 reqs/s
```

sanjay: quick smoke curl shows 500 still:
```
curl -v -X POST https://us-west1.edge.redwood/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":"test"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***'
< HTTP/2 500
{"error":"internal server error"}
```

maria: thanks. initial hypothesis: new quantization runtime/kernels in the canary are hitting a CUDA driver edge-case on this GPU sku. customer impact: internal batch jobs & a subset of embeddings for streaming customers in us-west1. not global yet.

ryan: tagging product: @prod-ops - increasing error rates for embeddings could affect search indexer jobs. any active deploys that might hit scheduled jobs?

maria: can we pause rollout and divert canary traffic back to stable? we should avoid full rollback unless needed. suggested immediate mitigation: 1) pause rollout 2) route canary traffic to stable 3) if errors persist, rollback canary deployment.

ops-bot: action: pause-rollout edge-v2-canary --initiator=maria
ops-bot: action: redirect-traffic edge-v2-canary -> edge-v1-stable (10.0.0.0/8 -> stable)

chen: confirming pause succeeded, traffic diversion applied. monitoring p95/p99.

leo: after diversion error rate dropped ~85% in us-west1 canary ring, but some hosts still showing kernel failures from earlier sessions.

maria: good. can someone grab the canary node build hash and kernel config? we need to open a regression ticket for build 2026.03.15-embed-quant.

chen: build hash = a1b2c3d4. kernel cfg: QUANT_KERNEL=avx2+cuda12, non-default cuBLAS flags.

ryan: product note: no paid customers reported visible outages yet but internal indexers delayed ~30m in certain regions. raising P1 if sustained.

maria: escalating to platform-sre for kernel patching and to research for quant path rollback. @sanjay can you start a rollback of the quant kernel on the canary nodes if we need it?

sanjay: starting rollback test on a single canary host now. will report.

incident-bot: Update: incident timeline updated on PD: https://pd.example/incidents/PD12345 - status=triage, assigned_to=maria.

maria: results: rollback on test host removed the cudnn crash and 500s stopped. plan: 1) keep rollout paused 2) rollback quant kernel on all canary hosts 3) run canary smoke for 15m then re-evaluate.

leo: creating internal ticket: INT-7839 with logs + repro steps. linking to PD.

maria: handing to next oncall for rollout ops: @chen please take over for execution of full rollback and monitoring. i'll stay in thread for context handoff.

chen: ack taking over - will run rollback across canary pool now and update PD.

ops-bot: action: rollback-quant-kernel --target=edge-v2-canary --confirm

chen: rollback started. will post progress.

maria: summary for execs: canary embed workload hit a kernel-level regression tied to a quantized runtime change in today's edge release. traffic was diverted and rollback mitigated errors. no broad customer-facing outage; internal batch latency impact noted. next steps: revert kernel change in release, add targeted test for quantized kernel on our GPU sku, and delay canary re-rollout until patch validated.

ryan: thx all. put a note on the weekly incident review.

pagerduty: Incident PD12345 updated: status=acknowledged by maria; responders=6.

chen: rollback completed, smoke green across canary pool. closing loop on mitigation. handing back to maria for incident write-up.

maria: thanks team — moving to postmortem draft. closing this thread. :white_check_mark:
